justifications.durability: no assertion is added and the relocation is observable only where the caller's TMPDIR lies under /tmp — logs/repro-tmp-basetemp.log records the four spawn-lane cases failing at f53e1750 in that geometry — so a revert reddens the gate there and passes silently elsewhere, and no assertion in the diff compares a value against one the test itself supplied.
